verdict.rationale: Temporal documents its own Worker Versioning feature: Worker Deployments, Worker Deployment Versions, and per-Workflow Pinned or Auto-Upgrade versioning behaviors. That covers the 'version' part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows a built-in review/approval step or a documented rollback to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented review workflow for automation changes, explicit rollback capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: You can declare each Workflow type to have a Versioning Behavior, either Pinned or Auto-Upgrade, in your Workflow config
Worker Deployments ... Worker Deployment Versions ... Versioning Behaviors
